hazards.control: Hands clear of slips, tongs, and the drawworks; guards on rotating parts.
Tubing handled with elevators and slips by trained crews; the derrick inspected before the job.

name: Tubing handling: elevators, slips, tongs, pipe racks
function: The tools that hold and make up tubing at the floor: elevators under the block, slips in the rotary or bowl, power tongs for make-up torque, and the racks that stage the joints.

tabs.overview: One joint per cycle: pick up from the rack, stab, make up with the tongs to the connection torque, pull the slips, lower, set the slips, latch the next joint.
tabs.engineering: Tong torque per the connection; slips sized to the tubing OD; elevators rated above the string weight.
tabs.safety: Hands clear of slips and tongs; thread protectors; tong line of fire.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
